name: @umbra/shell-electron
description: Lightweight image editor with a Photoshop-compatible workflow
author: elevchyt

scripts.spikes: pnpm --filter @umbra/app build && pnpm build && electron dist/main.js --spikes
scripts.parity: pnpm --filter @umbra/app build && pnpm build && electron dist/main.js --parity
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm --filter @umbra/app build && NODE_ENV=production node build.mjs && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
